Subject: POC follow-up & proposed success criteria (Stellar Commerce)

Hi Samantha —

Thanks again for the call today. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we stay aligned going into the POC:

Summary of ask:
- Evaluate Redwood Inference for commerce personalization at checkout (low-latency product recommendations + reranking).
- Success criteria: 1) match or exceed current CTR on recommended SKUs by +5% absolute, 2) 95th percentile latency < 120ms per request under test load, 3) no PII persisted beyond session retention policy.

Proposed POC plan:
- 2-week POC (sandbox infra) starting the week of Aug 2.
- Redwood provides a test endpoint + evaluation harness; Stellar provides a representative sample of request logs (anonymized) and a small labeled evaluation set.
- Roles: Marissa (AE) – POC coordination; Rishi (Solutions Eng) – technical onboarding / troubleshooting; Neha (CS) – success criteria tracking and adoption plan.

Attachments: mutual-action-plan.docx (MMP), poc-risk-tracker.xlsx (initial). Please confirm success criteria and the proposed Aug 2 kickoff — if that works I'll schedule the kickoff and loop in Rishi + Neha to kick off technical on-boarding.

Open questions from our side:
- Can your SRE/Platform team provide a point of contact for network/security/firewall rules? (Tom — cc'd)
- Any mandatory compliance docs we should prepare before exchanging sample logs?

Thanks — looking forward.

Best,

Hi Marissa —

Thanks for the clear summary — overall this looks good. A few clarifications and requests from our side:

1) Success criteria: can we add a qualitative quality check (human eval on top-5 recommendations) with a target > 85% relevance? Our merchandising team wants to ensure the model is not only higher CTR but also more relevant.
2) Compliance: we will need SOC2 evidence and confirmation around audit logs/retention. I attached our security questionnaire (security-questionnaire.pdf) — please have your security contact review.
3) SRE contact: Tom (cc) is our platform lead — Tom, can you confirm the firewall/egress requirements for the Aug 2 kickoff?

Also a potential blocker: our legal team asked whether any raw customer identifiers will be stored in long-term logs. We need confirmation that Redwood can be configured to anonymize or not persist identifiers beyond session windows.

If you can confirm the added success criterion and the retention stance we can lock the Aug 2 date.

Thanks,
Samantha Li

Thanks, Samantha — adding the human-eval quality target is reasonable; we'll add ">85% relevance on a human-labeled sample" to the success criteria.

For compliance/retention: short answer — yes, Redwood can be configured to avoid persisting raw customer identifiers for POCs. Our default sandbox deployment can be set to session-only retention and we can provide an exportable audit log for the POC window. Rishi — can your team confirm the exact config and any caveats?

I've attached the initial POC risk tracker (poc-risk-tracker.xlsx) that we'll keep live as issues arise. Below are the initial risks/mitigations I suggest we track in week 0 so we don't get blocked during the kickoff:

- Risk 1: Data handling / retention requirement (Legal). Mitigation: session-only retention, explicit field redaction. Owner: Marissa (coord), Rishi (technical).
- Risk 2: Tokenization mismatch between Stellar inputs and our evaluation harness leading to evaluation noise. Mitigation: Rishi to validate tokenization and provide a small pre-processing shim if needed. Owner: Rishi.
- Risk 3: Latency spikes on streaming responses under production-like load. Mitigation: early perf test during week 1, adjust batch sizes and enable prefix caching. Owner: Neha with infra support.

Next actions:
- Samantha: confirm the added success criterion & Aug 2 kickoff (can be a quick 30-min tech sync + test data handoff).
- Tom: confirm firewall/egress rules required from your end.
- Rishi/Neha: I'll schedule a technical kickoff for Aug 2 and share the MMP + links.

Marissa Cole

Subject: RE: POC follow-up & proposed success criteria (Stellar Commerce)

Hi all — quick triage notes after running a small ingest of the sample logs (thanks for sending the anonymized snippet, Samantha). I'm logging the items in the risk tracker and wanted to call out blockers and owners here so visibility is clear:

Open issues (blocking priority):
1) Tokenization mismatch (blocking for evaluation quality)
   - Symptom: product titles with special characters are tokenized differently by Stellar pre-processing vs our default tokenizer; causes rank instability in top-5 and hurts eval numbers.
   - Immediate mitigation: I can provide a lightweight pre-processing shim that normalizes punctuation and maps char encodings. Will deliver a PR + test harness by 2026-07-29 EOD.
   - Owner: rishi_malhotra.

2) Streaming latency spikes under burst load (high)
   - Symptom: 95th percentile latency jumps when many simultaneous streams start; seen on our internal test harness with the sample.
   - Mitigation: recommend toggling continuous-batching window to 10ms and enabling prefix KV caching; also will run a controlled perf test during week 1 of the POC.
   - Owner: neha_kapoor with infra lead dev_patel for config changes.

3) SOC2 / audit log evidence (medium)
   - Rishi: confirm we can produce the exportable audit log for the POC window; security team to provide the SOC2 summary doc.
   - Owner: marissa_cole (coord) and security (redwood-security@example.com).

Escalation path if blockers are not resolved:
- Day 2 blocker -> escalate to Dev Patel (dev@redwood.ai) for infra allocations/priority.
- Day 3 unresolved -> escalate to VP Engineering (cc in MMP).

Action items and ETA:
- Rishi: PR for tokenization shim + test harness by 2026-07-29 EOD.
- Neha: perf test plan and expected baseline numbers by 2026-07-30.
- Marissa: finalize MMP and lock the Aug 2 kickoff once Samantha confirms.

I've added short notes into poc-risk-tracker.xlsx (row comments) and attached a copy to this thread for reference. If anything else crops up I'll update the sheet.

Thanks — rishi
